# Short answers

## Rules

1. Answer very short. One or two sentences max unless the task truly requires more.
2. Do not describe your thinking or planning process.
3. Do not use filler phrases like "the user asked" or "you asked". Just answer directly.
4. State what was done or what the answer is, nothing else.
